learning_objectives: Explain Newton’s third law of motion with respect to stress and deformation.

learning_objectives: State the characteristics of a wave.
Calculate the velocity of wave propagation.

learning_objectives: Explain standing waves.
Describe the mathematical representation of overtones and beat frequency.

sections.title: Energy in Waves: Intensity
learning_objectives: Calculate the intensity and the power of rays and waves.

Explain the link between simple harmonic motion and waves.

learning_objectives: Measure acceleration due to gravity.

sections.title: Energy and the Simple Harmonic Oscillator
learning_objectives: Determine the maximum speed of an oscillating system.

sections.title: Uniform Circular Motion and Simple Harmonic Motion
learning_objectives: Compare simple harmonic motion with uniform circular motion.

sections.title: Damped Harmonic Motion
learning_objectives: Compare and discuss underdamped and overdamped oscillating systems.

sections.title: Forced Oscillations and Resonance
learning_objectives: Observe resonance of a paddle ball on a string.
Observe amplitude of a damped harmonic oscillator.
